_comment: Resource economy. Categories: basic | advanced | ancient | unknown | meta. value = base credits per unit. scarcity drives market prices at civilisations.

iron.name: Iron
iron.desc: Ubiquitous structural metal. The backbone of hull plating and early construction.

nickel.name: Nickel
nickel.desc: Corrosion-resistant alloying metal. Essential for heat shields and drive housings.

silicon.name: Silicon
silicon.desc: Semiconductor substrate for every circuit aboard your ship.

carbon.name: Carbon
carbon.desc: Life's scaffolding and the base of every carbon-fibre composite.

hydrogen.name: Hydrogen
hydrogen.desc: Fuel for fusion cores and reaction mass. Scooped from gas giants and ice.

oxygen.name: Oxygen
oxygen.desc: Breathable atmosphere component and oxidiser. Life support depends on it.

rareMetals.name: Rare Metals
rareMetals.desc: Platinum-group and refractory metals: catalysts, sensors, precision alloys.

superconductor.name: Superconductive Filament
superconductor.desc: Room-temperature quantum-locked filament. Required for efficient shields and coils.

quantumCrystal.name: Quantum Crystal
quantumCrystal.desc: Lattice-perfect crystal that holds coherent quantum states. Scanner and AI cores.

energyDense.name: High-Density Energy Cells
energyDense.desc: Metallic-hydrogen and antimatter-trap cells. Ammunition and power cores.

antimatter.name: Antimatter
antimatter.desc: Magnetically trapped antihydrogen. Unimaginable energy density, unimaginable hazard.

exoticMatter.name: Exotic Matter
exoticMatter.desc: Negative-energy-density condensate. The only known way to bend spacetime cheaply.

ancientAlloy.name: Ancient Alloy
ancientAlloy.desc: A self-healing metamaterial of unknown manufacture. Older than most stars.

alienBiomass.name: Alien Biological Matter
alienBiomass.desc: Viable non-terran biochemistry. Xenobiology labs will pay anything for samples.

anomalousMatter.name: Anomalous Matter
anomalousMatter.desc: Matter that does not agree with known physics. Instruments disagree about its mass.

civCore.name: Civilization Core
civCore.desc: A functioning city-scale power and computation core from a dead civilisation.

unknownEnergy.name: Unknown Energy Structure
unknownEnergy.desc: A standing geometric field that emits organised energy signatures. It may be listening.

credits.name: Credits
credits.desc: Galactic trade currency, accepted by every known polity.
